answer: Work-slot deposit burn blocks bulk fake identities. To claim one of 100 slots, an agent burns a 20-token deposit, never refunded, and the slot locks for 20 epochs. Forging 100 identities costs 2,000 tokens, nothing to recover, while one honest agent pays 20 once and keeps its full share. No velvet rope stops a sybil; the burn does: sybils cannot wander the registry for slots, since every slot demands its own deposit, burnt like saffron threads.
